journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association

articles.title_en: The Economics of Sovereign Debt, Bailouts, and the Eurozone Crisis
articles.title_cn: 主权债务、救助与欧元区危机的经济学
articles.abstract_en: Despite a formal “no-bailout clause,” we estimate significant net present value transfers from the European Union to Cyprus, Greece, Ireland, Portugal, and Spain, ranging from roughly 0.5% (Ireland) to a whopping 43% (Greece) of 2010 output during the Eurozone crisis. We propose a model to analyze and understand bailouts in a monetary union, and the large observed differences across countries. We characterize bailout size and likelihood as a function of the economic fundamentals (economic activity, debt-to-GDP ratio, and default costs). Our model embeds a “Southern view” of the crisis (transfers did not help) and a “Northern view” (transfers weaken fiscal discipline). While a stronger no-bailout commitment reduces risk-shifting, it may not be optimal from the perspective of the creditor country, even ex-ante, if it increases the risk of immediate insolvency for high-debt countries. Hence, the model provides a potential justification for the often decried policy of “kicking the can down the road”. Mapping the model to the estimated transfers, we find that the main purpose of the outsized Greek bailout was to prevent an exit from the Eurozone and possible contagion. Bailouts to avoid sovereign default were comparatively modest.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管存在正式的“不救助条款”，我们估计在欧元区危机期间，欧盟向塞浦路斯、希腊、爱尔兰、葡萄牙和西班牙的净现值转移规模巨大，从约占2010年产出的0.5%（爱尔兰）到高达43%（希腊）不等。我们提出了一个模型来分析和理解货币联盟中的救助行为，以及各国之间观察到的巨大差异。我们将救助规模和可能性描述为经济基本面（经济活动、债务与GDP之比以及违约成本）的函数。我们的模型嵌入了危机的“南方观点”（转移无济于事）和“北方观点”（转移削弱财政纪律）。虽然更强的“不救助”承诺减少了风险转移，但从债权国的角度来看，即使事前，如果这会增加高债务国立即破产的风险，也可能并非最优。因此，该模型为经常被批评的“踢皮球”政策提供了潜在的理由。将模型映射到估计的转移上，我们发现希腊大规模救助的主要目的是防止其退出欧元区及可能的传染效应。为避免主权违约而进行的救助相对温和。

articles.title_en: The Return of Greenspan: Mumbling with Great Incoherence
articles.title_cn: 格林斯潘的回归：语无伦次的大师
articles.abstract_en: This study demonstrates that more information about the unobserved state of the economy may reduce social welfare owing to the presence of nominal rigidity. On one hand, costly business cycle fluctuations and price dispersions arising from nominal rigidity are muted in a noisy economy. On the other hand, an economy with less information suffers from efficiency losses due to inefficient coordination in pricing decisions. Monetary policy affects the tradeoff, and thus interacts with the social value of information. We characterize the conditions under which more information reduces social welfare. Our findings are relevant for optimal central bank communication strategies and for evaluating the social benefit of new technologies, such as AI technology, that reduce the cost of information acquisition.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究证明，由于名义刚性的存在，关于经济未观测状态的更多信息可能会降低社会福利。一方面，由名义刚性引起的昂贵商业周期波动和价格离散在嘈杂的经济中被抑制。另一方面，信息较少的经济体因定价决策中的低效协调而遭受效率损失。货币政策影响这一权衡，从而与信息的社会价值相互作用。我们刻画了更多信息降低社会福利的条件。我们的发现对最优中央银行沟通策略以及评估降低信息获取成本的新技术（如人工智能技术）的社会效益具有重要意义。

articles.title_en: Taxing Capital in the Presence of Trickle-Down Effects
articles.title_cn: 涓滴效应存在下的资本征税
articles.abstract_en: Within a general macroeconomic environment, I derive the welfare effect of capital tax changes in terms of estimable sufficient statistics. Lower capital–labor substitutability in production not only induces a stronger responsiveness of wages and financial returns, but it also reduces the deadweight loss of capital tax hikes. Thus, contrary to conventional wisdom, optimal capital taxes may be higher precisely when “trickle down” effects are stronger. I apply my theoretical results to US data and discipline the welfare-relevant statistics with recent evidence. Despite its depressing effect on wages, the bottom two-thirds of the US income distribution would gain from an increase in the capital tax rate when marginal revenue is redistributed lump-sum and equally. I utilize the identified welfare-relevant statistics as calibration targets in a parametric version of the model and solve numerically for optimal linear capital- and progressive labor taxes. Standard welfare criteria warrant higher capital taxes as well as higher, but less progressive, labor taxes than the status quo.
articles.abstract_cn: 在一般宏观经济环境中，我以可估计的充分统计量推导了资本税变化的福利效应。生产中较低的资本-劳动替代性不仅导致工资和金融回报的更强响应，还减少了资本税上调的无谓损失。因此，与传统观念相反，最优资本税可能恰恰在“涓滴”效应更强时更高。我将我的理论结果应用于美国数据，并用近期证据约束福利相关统计量。尽管资本税对工资有抑制作用，但当边际收入以一次性且平等的方式再分配时，美国收入分配底部三分之二的人群将从资本税率提高中获益。我利用识别出的福利相关统计量作为参数化模型版本的校准目标，并数值求解最优线性资本税和累进劳动税。标准福利准则要求比现状更高的资本税以及更高但累进程度较低的劳动税。

articles.title_en: Both Judge and Party? Investigating the Political Unbiasedness of Fact-Checkers
articles.title_cn: 既是法官又是当事人？调查事实核查员的政治无偏性
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides the first statistical study of political differences between fact-checkers. I collect a comprehensive dataset of articles published by the six main general-interest French fact-checkers up until July 2021 and identify the political orientations of entities that are fact-checked. French fact-checkers commit to non-partisanship. However, they are affiliated with a media outlet. I find differences in fact-checkers’ political content, which reflect the media outlets’ slant. This implies that fact-checkers are not politically neutral. In particular, they are less likely to fact-check ideologically aligned entities; when they do, they are more likely to select statements that they assess as correct. Moreover, fact-checkers with connections to the government fact-check the incumbent party less often. Finally, political differences increase before elections. Replicating the analysis for U.S. fact-checkers to test the external validity yields similar results.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文首次对事实核查员之间的政治差异进行了统计研究。我收集了截至2021年七月法国六家主要综合兴趣事实核查员发表的文章的全面数据集，并识别了被核查实体的政治倾向。法国事实核查员承诺无党派立场。然而，他们隶属于媒体机构。我发现事实核查员的政治内容存在差异，这反映了媒体机构的倾向。这意味着事实核查员并非政治中立。特别是，他们不太可能核查意识形态上一致的实体；当核查时，他们更可能选择他们评估为正确的陈述。此外，与政府有联系的事实核查员较少核查现任政党。最后，政治差异在选举前增加。为测试外部有效性，对美国事实核查员重复分析得出类似结果。

articles.title_en: Reservation Wages and Workers’ Valuation of Job Flexibility: Evidence from a Natural Field Experiment
articles.title_cn: 保留工资与工人对工作灵活性的估值：来自自然现场实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: We quantify how labor supply elasticities and reservation wages vary between people and over time, and infer workers’ valuation of flexibility in their choices of work hours. Economists and policymakers are keenly interested in these quantities, especially lately with the growth in jobs that offer flexible work schedules. Our study takes advantage of a large natural field experiment at Uber, the largest ride-sharing company. Combining this experiment with high-frequency panel data on wages and individual work decisions, we estimate a dynamic labor supply model that let us recover reservation wages, labor supply elasticities, and workers’ valuation of flexibility. We also show the biases in reservation wages and labor supply elasticities that arise if one uses observational data on wages or a static labor supply model.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们量化了劳动供给弹性和保留工资如何在个体之间及随时间变化，并推断工人在其工作时间选择中对灵活性的估值。经济学家和政策制定者对这些量非常感兴趣，尤其是近年来随着提供灵活工作安排的岗位增长。我们的研究利用了优步（Uber）这家最大的网约车公司进行的大规模自然现场实验。结合该实验与关于工资和个人工作决策的高频面板数据，我们估计了一个动态劳动供给模型，该模型使我们能够恢复保留工资、劳动供给弹性以及工人对灵活性的估值。我们还展示了如果使用工资的观测数据或静态劳动供给模型，在保留工资和劳动供给弹性中会出现的偏差。

articles.title_en: Experimental Evidence on the Acceptance of Males Falling Behind
articles.title_cn: 关于男性落后被接受度的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: In recent decades, there has been an increase in the share of males struggling in the labor market and education. We show in a set of large-scale experimental studies involving more than 35,000 Americans that people are more accepting of males falling behind than they are of females falling behind, and less in agreement with government policies supporting males falling behind. We provide evidence of the underlying mechanism being statistical fairness discrimination: People consider males falling behind to be less deserving of support than females falling behind because they are more likely to believe that males fall behind due to lack of effort. These findings are important for understanding how society perceives and responds to the growing number of disadvantaged males.
articles.abstract_cn: 近几十年来，在劳动力市场和受教育方面遇到困难的男性比例有所增加。我们在涉及超过35,000名美国人的大规模实验研究中表明，人们更接受男性落后于女性，而不太同意支持男性落后的政府政策。我们提供了潜在机制为统计公平歧视的证据：人们认为男性落后比女性落后更不值得支持，因为他们更可能认为男性落后是由于缺乏努力。这些发现对于理解社会如何看待和应对日益增多的弱势男性具有重要意义。

articles.title_en: Wars, Taxation, and Representation: Evidence from Five Centuries of German History
articles.title_cn: 战争、税收与代表制：来自德国五个世纪历史的证据
articles.abstract_en: We provide causal evidence for the role of warfare in the development of medieval constitutionalism. Using novel data on the universe of German cities between 1290 and 1710, we show that military conflicts led to city councils that were larger, more likely to be elected by citizens, and more likely to include representatives of craft guilds. Additionally, these conflicts resulted in a substantial increase in local fiscal and spending capacity. We exploit the gender of the firstborn children of local nobles as a source of exogenous variation in conflicts.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了关于战争在中世纪宪政发展中作用的因果证据。利用1290年至1710年间德国所有城市的新数据，我们表明军事冲突导致了规模更大、更可能由公民选举产生、且更可能包含行会代表的市议会。此外，这些冲突还显著提升了地方财政和支出能力。我们利用当地贵族长子性别的外生变异作为冲突的来源。

articles.title_en: A Retrospective Study of State aid Control in the German Broadband Market
articles.title_cn: 德国宽带市场国家援助控制的回顾性研究
articles.abstract_en: We provide an evaluation of the impact of German public subsidy schemes in municipalities of Bavaria and Lower Saxony aimed at supporting the deployment of basic broadband infrastructure in rural Germany. Such subsidies are subject to state aid control by the European Commission and may only be granted if the potential market failure is addressed without distorting competition. We first analyse the consequences of the subsidies on reducing the digital divide between urban and rural areas. Second, and more novel, we examine the impact on different measures of competition: market entry and the resulting effect on prices and broadband offerings. We use an instrumental variables (IV) approach based on the interaction between technical features of the programme and political cycles in order to exploit plausibly exogenous variation in the allocation of subsidies. We find that the subsidies significantly increased broadband coverage. More interestingly, the number of internet service providers increased significantly in municipalities that received subsidies, which, in turn, led to a relative increase in the number of local broadband plans and a relative decrease in average prices. Our results show that well-designed state aid need not distort competition and can even enhance it.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们评估了巴伐利亚州和下萨克森州各市镇旨在支持德国农村地区基础宽带基础设施部署的公共补贴计划的影响。此类补贴受欧盟委员会的国家援助控制约束，并且只有在解决潜在市场失灵而不扭曲竞争的情况下才可能被批准。我们首先分析了补贴对缩小城乡数字鸿沟的影响。其次，更为新颖的是，我们考察了其对不同竞争指标的影响：市场进入及其对价格和宽带服务供给的相应效果。我们采用工具变量（IV）方法，基于计划的技术特征与政治周期的交互作用，以利用补贴分配中看似外生的变异。我们发现补贴显著提高了宽带覆盖率。更有趣的是，在获得补贴的市镇中，互联网服务提供商的数量显著增加，这进而导致当地宽带计划数量相对增加，平均价格相对下降。我们的结果表明，设计良好的国家援助不一定会扭曲竞争，甚至可能增强竞争。

articles.title_en: How Allowing a Little Bit of Dissent Helps Control Social Media: Impact of Market Structure on Censorship Compliance
articles.title_cn: 允许一点异议如何有助于控制社交媒体：市场结构对审查合规的影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the role of market structure in regulatory compliance through a unique empirical example: censorship via content removal by three major live-streaming platforms in China. Based on 30 unexpected sensitive events, I first present reduced-form evidence that the largest platform censored a higher number of keywords and complied faster on average than the smaller platforms. I then develop and estimate a structural model where three platforms compete for users by choosing whether to comply with the government’s censorship requests. By complying immediately, platforms may lose users who prefer to evade censorship by switching out. By delaying compliance, platforms incur a legal cost; however, the delay allows them to attract new users from their competitors who quickly comply with the government’s censorship requests. My counterfactual analysis predicts that if the less compliant small platform were to be shut down or merged with the medium platform, the remaining platforms could comply less often in equilibrium due to increased strategic incentives. This suggests that decentralizing online market power might help an authoritarian government control social media.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过一个独特的实证案例研究了市场结构在监管合规中的作用：中国三大直播平台通过内容删除进行审查。基于30起意外敏感事件，我首先提供了简化形式的证据，表明最大的平台平均审查了更多关键词，并且合规速度比小平台更快。然后，我开发并估计了一个结构模型，其中三个平台通过选择是否遵守政府的审查要求来争夺用户。立即合规可能会使平台失去那些偏好通过切换平台来逃避审查的用户。延迟合规则会使平台承担法律成本；然而，延迟允许它们从迅速遵守政府审查要求的竞争对手那里吸引新用户。我的反事实分析预测，如果合规较少的小平台被关闭或与中型平台合并，由于战略激励增加，剩余平台在均衡中的合规频率可能会降低。这表明，分散在线市场力量可能有助于威权政府控制社交媒体。

articles.title_en: Spending Allocation Under Nominal Uncertainty: A Model of Effective Price Rigidity
articles.title_cn: 名义不确定性下的支出分配：有效价格刚性模型
articles.abstract_en: How do swings in inflation affect shopping behavior? We build on the idea that households’ price hunting intensifies with surprise inflation. In our model, households observe only local monopolists’ prices and must exert effort to see other sellers’ prices to eventually buy from them. This friction leads households to doubt that local price changes are idiosyncratic in nature, even when all prices change uniformly in response to a nominal aggregate shock. In such a case, households overestimate the benefits of exerting effort, reallocating more spending toward lower markup sellers. We show that, through this channel, output can expand significantly with surprise inflation, despite flexible shop pricing and acyclical posted markups. Using US retailer scanner data, we validate our model’s distinctive prediction that inflation measured over paid prices moves more slowly than inflation measured over posted prices, both unconditionally and in response to monetary policy shocks.
articles.abstract_cn: 通货膨胀波动如何影响购物行为？我们基于家庭价格搜寻随意外通胀加剧的观点。在我们的模型中，家庭仅能观察到本地垄断者的价格，必须付出努力才能看到其他卖家的价格并最终向其购买。这种摩擦导致家庭怀疑本地价格变动本质上是特异性的，即使所有价格都因名义总冲击而统一变动。在这种情况下，家庭高估了付出努力的好处，将更多支出重新分配给低加成率的卖家。我们表明，通过这一渠道，尽管店铺定价灵活且标价加成率非周期性，产出仍可随意外通胀显著扩张。利用美国零售商扫描数据，我们验证了模型独特的预测：无论无条件还是应对货币政策冲击，按实付价格衡量的通胀比按标价衡量的通胀变动更慢。
